### Task 2: Security regression tests (TDD)

**Files:**
- Create `app/src/test/java/app/openflow/security/LaunchSecurityTest.kt`

- [ ] **Step 1: Failing test** (file missing)

```kotlin
package app.openflow.security

import com.google.common.truth.Truth.assertThat
import org.junit.Test
import java.io.File

class LaunchSecurityTest {
    private fun repoFile(vararg parts: String): File {
        var dir = File(System.getProperty("user.dir")!!)
        repeat(6) {
            val hit = parts.fold(dir) { acc, p -> File(acc, p) }
            if (hit.isFile) return hit
            dir = dir.parentFile ?: dir
        }
        return parts.fold(File(System.getProperty("user.dir")!!)) { acc, p -> File(acc, p) }
    }

    @Test
    fun manifest_has_no_internet() {
        val xml = repoFile("src", "main", "AndroidManifest.xml").readText()
        assertThat(xml).doesNotContain("android.permission.INTERNET")
        assertThat(xml).contains("allowBackup=\"false\"")
        assertThat(xml).contains("BIND_ACCESSIBILITY_SERVICE")
    }

    @Test
    fun cleartext_blocked() {
        val xml = repoFile("src", "main", "res", "xml", "network_security_config.xml").readText()
        assertThat(xml).contains("cleartextTrafficPermitted=\"false\"")
    }

    @Test
    fun backup_excludes_private_stores() {
        val xml = repoFile("src", "main", "res", "xml", "data_extraction_rules.xml").readText()
        assertThat(xml).contains("domain=\"database\"")
        assertThat(xml).contains("domain=\"sharedpref\"")
    }
}
```

Unit tests run with `user.dir` = `app/`. Path `src/main/AndroidManifest.xml` is correct.

- [ ] RED then GREEN (tests pass against current XML; no prod change unless a test finds a real hole)
